documents.title: Board Meeting Outcome for Outcome Of The Board Meeting
Compliances-Certificate under Reg. 74 (5) of SEBI (DP) Regulations, 2018

analysis.summary: Amal Ltd reported a 77% increase in consolidated sales to Rs 240 crore for FY 2025-26, largely driven by a 164% spike in Sulphur raw material prices. Consolidated PBT decreased by 14% to Rs 28 crore as the company could not fully absorb the increase in input costs. The company remains debt-free, with cash surplus increasing by Rs 16 crore to Rs 38 crore and a recommended dividend of Rs 1.5 per share. Three CapEx projects are currently under implementation, while two additional growth projects are under evaluation. Amal Ltd reported consolidated revenue from operations of Rs 13,532 lakh and profit before tax of Rs 3,261 lakh for FY 2024-25.
